inj.note: Fuaga is dealing with a knee sprain that he sustained during Thursday's practice, per reporters.com. However, head coach Kellen Moore indicated Friday that he doesn't expect Fuaga to be sidelined long term, as reported by reporters WWL Radio. Mason Murphy and Asim Richards are the top candidates to start at right tackle in Fuaga's absence.

news.h: Taliese Fuaga out with knee sprain vs. Panthers
news.d: Report on the Saints being without Taliese Fuaga and the possibility of Travis Etienne returning Sunday vs. the Panthers.
